results.title: Tom & Cherry
results.overview: When Tom suddenly disappears, a mysterious man named Cheer becomes part of an extraordinary journey that no one sees coming. Packed with laughter, emotions, unexpected twists, and heartwarming moments, Tom and Cherry is a wholesome family entertainer that celebrates the true meaning of love and togetherness.

results.title: Tradwife
results.overview: An actress turned tradwife influencer finally finds her dream audience, but when a troll exposes the cracks in her picture-perfect marriage during a livestream, she stages a high-stakes dinner that might just save her show–or end the act for good.

results.title: Method to the Madness
results.overview: After winning a chance to honor her late basketball-star twin sister, an awkward woman hires an unconventional basketball coach to prepare for a high-stakes free throw. As training grows increasingly unpredictable, an unlikely friendship challenges both women to confront grief, self-doubt, and the courage to believe in themselves.

results.title: Odium Zero
results.overview: 14 days ago, a comet ripped across the sky, unleashing the disaster now known as the Grayfall. Within hours, parasitic spores called Gray Matters transformed people into savage monsters known as Spikers, collapsing society overnight. Governments sealed off infected cities, buried the truth, and left the outbreak zones to rot. 16-year-old influencer Mai, refusing to believe the official story, breaks into Central Hospital—the outbreak’s ground zero—with her AI cobot, BooBoo. Inside, fear spreads faster than the infection as survivors turn on each other. After rescuing a little girl named Anna, Mai fights to escape a hospital overrun by Spikers. Her path collides with Ren Cade, a ruthless black-ops commander hunting her, while Dr. Theodore secretly pulls the strings from mission control. But Theodore has one more ace up his sleeve: Ares, a genetically engineered killing machine built for one job—and one job only: to take Mai down.

results.title: The Symphony of Dance
results.overview: A behind-the-scenes glimpse at a marathon of performances by Dancing with the Stars’ Derek and Hayley Hough becomes something entirely different when Hayley is forced to fight for her life following a shocking health crisis.

results.title: Echoes
results.overview: In a quirky, heartfelt journey sparked by accidental edibles, three generations of women rediscover the love, happiness, and shared identity they hold as a family.

results.title: The Home Resort
results.overview: In a society where going on holiday is a matter of prestige, one family will do everything they can to maintain their social status, for which they have fought tirelessly for years, by spending ten days locked in their apartment, pretending to be on vacation.

results.title: Same As It Ever Was
results.overview: When two gunmen come for Justin Johnson, he needs to choose between casual Fridays or the things that are once in a lifetime.

results.title: Annem Hakkında
results.overview: At a summer resort, a large family gathers to celebrate the fifth anniversary of Aysel's death and hold a Mawlid recitation. The gathering, which brings together the woman's son Caner, her ex-husband Muharrem, her brother Halil, her sister-in-law Nermin, and her sister Halime, sparks unexpected arguments and turns their relationship upside down.

results.title: Karlovy Vary
results.overview: Sung-jae, an aspiring filmmaker, writes a screenplay set in the beautiful Czech city of Karlovy Vary, wins several competitions, and even secures funding to make his film. It seems like everything he has ever dreamed of is finally coming true. After completing the shoot in Korea, all that remains is to travel to Karlovy Vary for the final scenes. But then, disaster strikes, the entire production budget suddenly vanishes. With no money left and no way to abandon the project, Sung-jae and his friends must somehow finish the film without ever setting foot in Karlovy Vary. Can they pull off the impossible and save their movie?

results.title: Imminence @ Hellfest 2025
results.overview: With Imminence, metal brings out the violins... literally. The Swedes strike a chord at Hellfest with metalcore as melancholy as it is melodic, where the intensity of the guitars blends with the delicacy of classical violin.

results.title: Gemini, The Apple Of My Eye!
results.original_title: Gemini, The Apple Of My Eye!
results.overview: Returning to his childhood home, Kerry and his partner Gina become trapped in a surreal reality that forces long-buried family memories to resurface.

results.title: Дар заборава (сага о ревизионизму)
results.overview: The Gift of Forgetting explores how the memory of World War II in the post-Yugoslavia region has been transformed into a tool of political manipulation. The film follows the ways in which historical facts are gradually reshaped, relativized, or instrumentalized within contemporary national narratives.

results.title: If You Can Make It Here
results.original_title: If You Can Make It Here
results.overview: Kingsley, Kevin, and Hailey are three ambitious eighth graders preparing for a single exam that could determine their futures. They’re competing for admission to New York City’s Specialized High Schools, elite public institutions that have produced Nobel Prize laureates, astronauts, judges, artists, and national leaders. But as the kids await their test results, a citywide battle is raging over who should attend these schools—the kids who score highest on the entrance exam or the kids who improve diversity. Featuring interviews with kids, parents, and education leaders, If You Can Make It Here places young students at the center of a high-stakes cultural conflict over the future of equity and excellence in public education.

results.title: Barbara Hannigan: Soprano and Conductor
results.overview: From Canada to Europe’s great opera houses, soprano Barbara Hannigan builds a fearless career defined by risk, precision and emotional intensity.
